title: F126.1 delete the old evals: the overview
caption: Four moves, from the outside in: the sites stop naming the evals, the pages and the studio go, the harness goes, and the record and the words are made true. What the new evals will stand on stays.

cards.title: F126.1 Delete the old evals
cards.text: Today's evals leave the repository whole, so the new ones are built into empty folders under their real names.

cards.title: The sites let go
cards.text: The starter and the demo stop naming the eval area and mapping its API. The demo's three evals and its runner go.

cards.title: The pages and the studio go
cards.text: The eval pages, the tests that stood on the studio, the studio's API and the admin records only they used.

cards.title: The harness goes
cards.text: The four projects under src/evals, their tests, the one package only they used, and the rule tests that named them.

cards.title: The record and the words
cards.text: One ADR in place of nine, the docs that described the old evals, and what the live sites say.

cards.title: Stays: the engine's replay
cards.text: Recorded model and web answers, which a free replay will play back.

cards.title: Stays: the sessions API
cards.text: The door a run will ask the agent through, like any app.

cards.title: Stays: the usage ledger
cards.text: The only source of what a run costs.
